Indikator 10 measures the mortality rate among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five administrative regions. For the reporting period spanning July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the national mortality rate was 7.6% [^src1]. 

When evaluating regional performance, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] recorded the highest mortality rate at 7.9%, representing 2,460 deaths out of 31,244 patients [^src1]. At the other end of the spectrum, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] emerged as the leader with the lowest regional mortality rate at 7.4% (2,177 deaths out of 29,495 patients) [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] both reported a 7.5% mortality rate, while [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] matched the national average of 7.6% [^src1].

Despite these regional variations, the data reveals a universal failure to meet the established clinical standards. The "Standard opfyldt" (Standard met) metric is recorded at 0% for the national average and every individual region, indicating that no geographical unit successfully achieved the target threshold for this indicator [^src1].

Because this comparison is drawn from a single dated section, it does not support a multi-section trend analysis. However, the table includes historical data columns for the 2020/21 and 2021/22 periods. Within these historical columns, an outlier pattern emerges: both [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] experienced notable mortality spikes in 2021/22, reaching 8.3% and 8.2% respectively, before declining in the current 2022/23 period [^src1].

Entities: danmark, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner mortalitetsandelen for prævalente atrieflimren-patienter på nationalt, regionalt og kommunalt niveau for perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023, og viser en landsomfattende andel på 7,6 % med regional variation fra 7,4 % (Midtjylland) til 7,9 % (Syddanmark).
